# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** open a public issue for security problems.

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](../../security/advisories/new)
(the "Report a vulnerability" button on this repo's Security tab).

Include what you found, steps to reproduce, and the affected version.
You should get a reply within 7 days. Please give us a reasonable
window to ship a fix before disclosing publicly.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.
